capabilities: Capture code snippets with language, framework, tags, description, and code block
Document architecture and design patterns with categories and examples
Search snippets and patterns by tag
Browse snippets and patterns in a sidebar filterable by language
Configure snippets and patterns folders in settings
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for collecting and retrieving reusable code snippets and architecture patterns by language or framework.
summary: Coding reference library that stores code snippets and design patterns as tagged Markdown notes with a filterable browsing sidebar.
